definitions.explanation: The flow of electric charge through a conductor, measured in amperes. Used in both technical and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {電流|でんりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
{電流|でんりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アンペアだ。
examples.english: The unit of electric current is the ampere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電線|でんせん}→電線：11507_densen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{電流|でんりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}れて→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: If you touch the power line, a strong electric current will flow through your body, which is dangerous.

notes:
Composed of {電|でん} (electricity) + {流|りゅう} (flow, current). A fundamental physics and engineering term, but also commonly encountered in everyday life in safety warnings and product specifications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電流|でんりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: electric current flows
- {電流|でんりゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: to pass an electric current
- {直流|ちょくりゅう}{電流|でんりゅう}: direct current (DC)
- {交流|こうりゅう}{電流|でんりゅう}: alternating current (AC)
- {電流|でんりゅう}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: current limiting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{電圧|でんあつ}→電圧：19996_denatsu⟧: voltage — the electrical potential difference that drives current
- ⟦{電力|でんりょく}→電力：14609_denryoku⟧: electric power — the rate of energy transfer, measured in watts
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧: electricity — the general term covering electrical phenomena and power supply
